text:
The actual expression is, as far as the packet shows, a verbatim repetition of the frozen `corpus.text`. Its opening, its ten disagreements, and its final paragraph all match the source. So there is no translator-side loss between the frozen prose and the actual expression. The interesting losses and additions appear in the independent reading and in the two proposed languages, Lean WHL and RSS.

## The independent reading

The reading says: “Literally, it says that such a snapshot is not a single ledger but a bag of records—orderless, possibly duplicated, stale, or contradictory.” But the source distinguishes two levels:

> “A replicated warehouse snapshot is not a single ledger but a cloud of rival stories about what has been promised. The capacity and logical time are shared coordinates, but the records arrive as a bag…”

The snapshot is a cloud of rival stories; the records are a bag. The reading collapses the snapshot into the bag. That loses the source’s story/record distinction, which matters later when the source asks whether “true” means anything and whether alternatives are records or quantities.

The reading also treats the source as withheld. It says: “because the source corpus field is withheld, none of this establishes that the source language actually carried those categories,” and it says the “essayistic apparatus—‘first useful conjecture,’ ‘deliberate refusal,’ ‘Now the disagreements begin,’ ‘A conjecture,’ ‘A criticism,’ ‘keeping these disagreements visible’—is almost certainly carrier-side prose escape, not source content.” But the source is not withheld in this packet, and those phrases are in the frozen source itself. The defect is therefore in the probe or reader perspective, not in the expression. It is a source-text-withheld reading being applied where the source text is available.

There is an internal tension about expiry. The reading says the expression’s assumptions include “expiry as effect rather than deletion,” yet it also lists “whether expiry deletes or only zeroes” among what is left unresolved. The source is more precise:

> “The snapshot description tilts toward the first… So the first is better supported, but the second remains a live conjecture…”

The reading flattens that tilt into both an assumption and an open question. A proposed repair would be to preserve the source’s asymmetry: effect is better supported, deletion remains live.

The reading also introduces “a total order on revisions” as an assumption. The source only says higher revision supersedes lower revision. It does not state trichotomy, antisymmetry, or totality. That is an added formal commitment. Similarly, “descriptive or normative” and the meta-textual allegory reading are interpretive additions, not explicit source content. They may be admissible, but they should be marked as added.

## Lean WHL

The Lean sketch is declared as a language, not a translation, so its defects are in the carrier and compiler bridge. Several are concrete.

First, the code is not Lean-core-compatible as claimed. `Quantity` is an axiom, but `list_min?` and `list_max?` use `<` and `>` on `Quantity`. `availability_lower_bound` folds with `acc + booking_lower_bound snap b` starting from `0`, but `booking_lower_bound` returns `Quantity`, not `Nat`. `Int.sub_nat` expects `Nat`, but receives `Quantity`. `rules_disagree` uses `possible_reservations_with` before that definition appears. The inductive `Int` shadows Lean’s core `Int`. These are compiler-bridge defects. A repaired Lean could still encode more; the failure does not prove Lean cannot express the distinctions.

The semantic losses are more important. The source says:

> “Duplicate delivery of the same booking, revision, kind, quantity, and expiry adds nothing; authority does not accumulate by repetition.”

Lean defines `exact_duplicate`, but `possible_reservations` still maps every record at the greatest revision:

```lean
(rs.filter (λ r, r.booking = b ∧ greatest_revision_in rs r)).map (reserves_effect t)
```

If two exact duplicate active holds tie at the greatest revision, the resulting `List Quantity` can contain the same quantity twice. `list_min?` and `list_max?` ignore that for bounds, but the list itself can be read as multiple alternatives. The duplicate is not fully inert in the representation. A proposed repair would filter exact duplicates before mapping, or represent possible reservations as a set/quotient.

The source says:

> “Different records tied at a greatest revision can remain unresolved alternatives…”

But Lean’s `possible_reservations` maps records to `Quantity`. Two tied records with the same quantity but different expiry or kind collapse to the same quantity. The alternative is a record, not just a number. This loses the ability to criticize a particular record among tied alternatives. A proposed repair would preserve record identity, perhaps returning `List Record` or a set of records plus their effects.

The largest Lean defect is expiry. The source says:

> “Another reading treats expiry as deleting the record from the bag, after which revision 3 becomes greatest and active, so the booking reserves again.”

Lean defines `expired_deletes_rule`, but it is identical to `reserves_effect`: an expired hold maps to zero, and a release maps to zero. `possible_reservations_with` still uses `greatest_revision_in rs r` on the original list. So revision 5 remains greatest; revision 3 never becomes greatest. The “deletion” reading is named but not implemented. A proposed repair would make a reading transform the snapshot or the greatest-revision relation before computing reservations.

The source also says:

> “One can criticize a reconstruction rule, a particular record, a booking’s history, the snapshot as a whole, or the assumption that logical time is meaningful.”

Lean defines `Conjecture : Type := Snapshot → Prop` and `Refutation` only over `Conjecture`. Rule criticism is not directly a `Conjecture`; `rules_disagree` is only a `Prop`. This narrows what criticism can target. A proposed repair would parameterize conjectures over a target type, or define separate conjecture/refutation structures for rules, records, bookings, and assumptions.

Lean admits it does not model source-assumption dependence, replication, per-replica logical time, or physical resource sharing beyond capacity. Those admissions are honest, but they are still lost distinctions. In particular, the source warns:

> “intervals lose correlations: booking A’s high alternative might be incompatible with booking B’s high alternative if they share a physical resource not named in the snapshot.”

Lean’s `availability_lower_bound` and `availability_upper_bound` sum independent per-booking minima and maxima. That can produce an interval wider than any actually possible combination. The language notes the limitation, but it cannot express the correlation.

## RSS

RSS adds a richer ontology: Story, Bag, Coordinate, Viewpoint, Conflict, Liveness, Reading, Projection, Account, Inquiry State. This is not wrong as a proposed language, but it is not neutral. It says:

> “A story is not a record. Records are evidence for stories.”

The source says the snapshot is a “cloud of rival stories,” but it also says “the records arrive as a bag.” It does not say records are evidence for stories. RSS introduces a layer between records and stories. That may be useful, but it changes the base object of the reconstruction.

RSS also changes exact duplication. The source says duplicates are the same in booking, revision, kind, quantity, and expiry. RSS says:

> “Exact duplication: two deliveries are exact duplicates if all record fields and provenance are equal.”

Adding provenance to duplicate identity means two deliveries with the same five source fields but different provenance are not exact duplicates under RSS. That contradicts the source’s five-field rule. A proposed repair would keep exact duplication on the five fields and treat provenance separately.

RSS treats coordinates as viewpoint-relative:

> “RSS treats coordinates as parameters of a viewpoint, not as absolute facts.”

The source says capacity and logical time are “shared coordinates.” It later allows that different replicas may have different logical times, so a viewpoint-relative treatment is a possible reading. But RSS makes it the default, losing the shared-coordinate baseline.

RSS also flattens the source’s tilt on expiry. The source says the first reading is “better supported,” while the second “remains a live conjecture.” RSS says:

> “RSS does not choose a reading. It compares readings.”

That preserves coexistence but loses the support relation. A proposed repair would add a relation of evidential support between readings, not only a set of readings.

RSS adds that deliveries may differ in logical time. The source says different replicas may have different logical times; it does not say deliveries carry logical time. That is an added commitment. RSS also has an internal inconsistency: it makes provenance a primitive, then says in its limitations that “RSS cannot express the exact provenance of a delivery unless provenance is added.” A proposed repair would remove one side of that contradiction.

To RSS’s credit, it preserves more of the source’s disagreement structure than Lean does. It distinguishes exact and near duplicates, represents multiple readings of expiry and release, allows criticism to target records, rules, bookings, snapshots, coordinates, or assumptions, and carries negative availability as a signal rather than an error. Its noncomputability also honestly reflects the source’s refusal to force a single answer, though it may obstruct the source’s “natural reconstruction” procedure.

## Disposition

The actual expression is faithful to the frozen source. The independent reading is partly misdirected by its source-withheld stance and collapses the story/record distinction. Lean WHL has concrete compiler-bridge errors and semantic gaps around duplicate inertness, record identity, expiry deletion, and criticism targets. RSS introduces an added ontology and misaligns exact duplication with provenance, but it preserves more of the source’s pluralism.

These are proposed repairs only; the source and languages remain frozen. The meta-textual allegory reading remains a competing interpretation. The expiry-deletion reading remains live but less supported. Neither Lean nor RSS is an obligatory grammar for the prose. A substantive prose objection remains admissible even where a selected formal language cannot encode it—for example, that tied alternatives are records, not merely quantities, and that a duplicate delivery must not become a second alternative merely because it appears twice in a list.
